### What We Build
As Bengaluru's full-spectrum construction company, Neelachandra handles every phase of a project from the first architectural drawing to key handover. Whether building a home in Nelamangala, a commercial complex on Tumkur Road, or an industrial facility in Doddaballapura, one team delivers it all to the same standard.

**Residential Construction** — Custom homes, independent villas and multi-storey residential buildings built to the client's exact brief, using BIS-certified materials backed by a 10-year structural warranty. No cut corners, no price changes after signing.

**Commercial & Industrial Projects** — From office buildings on Tumkur Road to 85,000 sq ft industrial sheds in Bengaluru's KIADB estates, Neelachandra delivers large-scale commercial and industrial construction for developers, OEM manufacturers and institutional clients. 

**Interior Design & Fit-out** — Complete interior solutions for homes and offices across Bengaluru including modular kitchens, false ceilings, custom wardrobes, marble flooring and ambient lighting. Available standalone or bundled with any construction package. See the Interiors section below for full details.

**Infrastructure Projects** — A turnkey model covering design, plan approvals, construction and interior finish as a single workflow from concept to handover, with one contract and one point of contact. Ideal for busy professionals and NRI clients building in Bengaluru.

**Renovation & Retrofitting** — Structural upgrades, elevation redesigns, interior remodelling and space reconfiguration without disrupting daily life, serving homeowners and businesses across Bengaluru, Nelamangala and Tumkur Road.

**Approvals & Documentation** — An in-house compliance team manages BBMP, BMRDA, and Gram Panchayat plan approvals, soil testing reports and all statutory drawings, saving clients weeks of follow-up with government offices.

### Our Process
Every Neelachandra project follows a transparent, milestone-driven process:

1. **Consult & Plan** — The client shares plot location, approximate area and vision. Discussion and commitment. A dedicated Project Coordinator is assigned, a site visit and soil test are conducted.
2. **Design & Approve** — The client reviews 2D floor plans, 3D elevations and structural drawings. The full scope, material specifications, timeline and total cost are finalised in a signed agreement. Price is locked, with no changes without written approval. Work starts.
3. **Build & Update** — Construction begins with branded, BIS-certified materials fully documented at every stage. The Project Coordinator sends weekly progress reports with site photos, and 24x7 live site access lets clients check in remotely.
4. **Handover & Move In** — A full quality walkthrough is conducted before handover; clients sign off only when satisfied. Keys, warranty documents, compliance certificates and as-built drawings are all handed over on the same day.

### Overview
How much does house construction cost in Bengaluru? Neelachandra's residential construction packages start at ₹2,299 per sq ft. Four package tiers — Silver, Platinum, Gold and Diamond — cover every finish level from essential quality builds to premium luxury homes across Bengaluru and Karnataka.

- 4 Packages Available
- ₹2,299/sqft Starting from
- 100% Transparent Specifications
- Zero Hidden Costs
- 10 Year Structural Warranty
- Serving All of Bengaluru

Every tier includes soil testing, anti-termite treatment, Fosroc and Dr. Fixit waterproofing, rainwater harvesting and an overhead tank as standard inclusions, with no surprise upgrades or hidden charges.

### Package Tiers
- **Silver** — Quality Construction, Smart Budget — ₹2,299/sqft
- **Platinum** — Enhanced Comfort, Better Finishes — ₹2,699/sqft
- **Gold** — Premium Living, Smart Home Ready — ₹3,099/sqft (Most Popular)
- **Diamond** — Ultra-Luxury, Nothing Compromised — ₹3,499/sqft

### Why Homeowners Choose Neelachandra Construction Packages
- **Fixed Price, No Escalation** — Material rates are fixed at signing, shielding clients from market fluctuations. Every material is branded, BIS certified and fully traceable, with no substitutions or cost cutting.
- **Branded Materials, Documented Procurement** — Each package specifies exact brands used, including Ultratech, Ramco or Maha cement, JSW, Indus or A-One TMT steel, Finolex electrical wiring, Asian Paints finishes and Jaquar plumbing fittings, with all procurement records documented.
- **10 Year Structural Warranty Every Package** — Every Neelachandra home in Bengaluru is protected by a 10-year structural warranty as a standard commitment, never a paid upgrade.
- **One Project Coordinator, Zero Confusion** — A dedicated project coordinator manages the complete residential build; all site decisions, progress updates, and approvals go through this single contact point.
- **Built Specifically for Bengaluru** — Deep knowledge of Bengaluru soil profiles, local vendor networks, and BBMP, BMRDA and Gram Panchayat approval workflows.

### Packages / Pricing FAQ

**Q: How much does it cost to build a house in Bengaluru in 2026?**
A: Construction costs range from ₹2,299 per sq ft (Silver) to ₹3,499 per sq ft (Diamond). For a standard 1,200 sq ft home, this translates to roughly ₹27 lakhs to ₹42 lakhs. These are fully turnkey rates covering design, structure, basic finishes, plumbing, and electricals.

**Q: How much does it cost to build a house on a 30×40 site in Bengaluru?**
A: A 30×40 plot (1,200 sq ft) with a G+1 structure typically yields 1,800–2,000 sq ft of built-up area. Using the Gold package at ₹3,099 per sq ft, the total cost ranges from ₹55 lakhs to ₹62 lakhs, complete with premium finishes and smart home automation.

**Q: What is included in your turnkey construction packages?**
A: Every package includes structural and architectural design, soil testing, excavation, RCC framework (using branded steel and cement), masonry, internal and external plastering, flooring, painting, electrical wiring, plumbing, waterproofing, an underground sump, and an overhead tank.

**Q: Are there hidden costs? What is excluded from the per sq ft rate?**
A: All exclusions are stated upfront in the detailed estimate. Items outside the base rate include: government statutory fees (BBMP/BMRDA), temporary BESCOM/BWSSB meter deposits, borewell drilling, external compound walls, and hard rock-breaking if required during excavation.

**Q: What if cement or steel prices rise during construction?**
A: Once the agreement is signed, the per sq ft price is completely locked. Neelachandra absorbs all market fluctuations on the branded materials specified in the contract. No cost escalation unless the client formally requests a scope change or material upgrade.

**Q: How is the payment schedule structured?**
A: A milestone-based payment schedule across 10–12 stages tied directly to physical site progress — footing completion, plinth level, individual slab castings, plastering, and so on. No large lump sum is paid upfront.

**Q: Are BBMP or BMRDA plan approval fees included in the package?**
A: Neelachandra handles the complete liaison, documentation, and architectural drawings required for BBMP, BMRDA, or Gram Panchayat plan sanctions. Actual statutory fees, taxes, and government deposits are paid directly by the property owner as required by law.

**Q: Is a soil test mandatory before building in Bengaluru?**
A: Yes, and it is included in all packages. Bengaluru's soil varies drastically from hard rock to loose earth. Testing lets structural engineers design the correct footing depth and foundation type.

**Q: Do you assist with permanent BESCOM and BWSSB connections?**
A: Yes. Neelachandra prepares the technical documentation, building plans, and structural completion certificates required to apply for permanent BESCOM electricity allocation and BWSSB water and sewerage lines.

**Q: Do packages include rainwater harvesting and underground sumps?**
A: Yes. All residential packages include an underground water sump sized for the built-up area, a branded overhead tank, and a complete rainwater harvesting system compliant with BBMP regulations.

**Q: What brands of cement and steel do you use?**
A: Exclusively Tier-1 materials. For cement: UltraTech, ACC, or Birla Super (OPC 53 Grade for structural works). For TMT steel: JSW Neo, Tata Tiscon, or Indus (Fe500D or Fe550D), specified per package and stated in the agreement.

**Q: How do you ensure concrete strength and quality on site?**
A: Slump tests are run before every concrete pour, and cubes are cast for 7-day and 28-day compressive strength testing at certified third-party laboratories. Test reports are included in project documentation.

**Q: Can I upgrade specific materials like flooring or bathroom fittings?**
A: Yes. Packages are fully flexible. A client on the Silver package who wants Italian marble or premium Kohler fittings simply pays the differential between the package allowance and the chosen upgrade.

**Q: What warranty do you provide after handover?**
A: Every Neelachandra home comes with a 10-year structural warranty covering foundations, columns, beams, and slabs, plus a 1-year warranty on waterproofing integrity and general plumbing and electrical fixtures.

**Q: How long does it take to build a G+1 or G+2 house in Bengaluru?**
A: A standard G+1 or G+2 home takes 10 to 14 months from excavation to final handover, with a binding timeline and sub-milestones attached to the agreement.

**Q: Will there be a dedicated site engineer on my project?**
A: Yes. A dedicated, qualified site engineer oversees daily labor, ensures adherence to structural drawings, coordinates material delivery, and performs routine quality checks.

**Q: Do your rates apply across all of Bengaluru?**
A: Yes. Package rates apply uniformly across Bengaluru, including North Bengaluru, Tumkur Road, Doddaballapura, Whitefield, and Sarjapur. Site-specific factors like narrow road access are assessed during the free site visit and quoted transparently.

### Services FAQ

**Q: Can I hire Neelachandra only for architectural design without a construction contract?**
A: Yes, Neelachandra offers standalone architectural and structural design services across Bengaluru. Clients can hire the team exclusively to create floor plans, 3D elevations, structural blueprints, and electrical/plumbing layouts, even if planning to use an independent contractor for the physical construction.

**Q: What drawings are included in a standalone architectural design package?**
A: A comprehensive, execution-ready blueprint set including 2D floor plans, 3D exterior elevations, structural column and footing layouts, detailed center-line drawings, electrical routing charts, plumbing line designs, and municipal approval drawings optimized for BBMP or BMRDA sanctions.

**Q: Do your independent architectural services include structural engineering certifications?**
A: Yes. Every standalone architectural project includes structural calculations and load-bearing designs vetted by certified structural engineers, including stability certifications required by local authorities and financial institutions for home loan approvals in Bengaluru.

**Q: What types of property renovation services do you offer in Bengaluru?**
A: Turnkey residential and commercial renovation services including structural modifications, building extensions (adding extra floors), full interior remodeling, modular kitchen upgrades, bathroom waterproofing overhauls, exterior painting, and structural strengthening for older independent houses.

**Q: Can Neelachandra renovate an old independent house to add a new floor?**
A: Yes. Before adding a new floor, the engineering team conducts a structural health assessment and non-destructive testing (NDT) to check foundation strength. If the existing structure allows, Neelachandra manages structural reinforcement, architectural layout matching, and execution.

**Q: How do you estimate the cost of a house renovation project?**
A: Renovation costs are calculated based on a detailed bill of quantities (BOQ) rather than a flat per-square-foot rate, following a free site inspection to assess structural condition and map requirements.

**Q: Do I need BBMP plan approval for structural renovations or extensions?**
A: Internal modifications and minor repairs do not require formal approvals. Structural extensions — such as adding a first or second floor — require revised building plan sanctions from BBMP, BMRDA, or the relevant local panchayat. Neelachandra assists with this documentation process.

**Q: What waterproofing services do you provide for existing buildings in Bengaluru?**
A: Advanced, multi-layer waterproofing systems including terrace waterproofing (polyurethane or crystalline coatings), bathroom tile grouting, external wall dampness treatment, overhead water tank sealing, and heavy-duty basement waterproofing to resist high water tables.

**Q: How long does terrace waterproofing take for a standard house in Bengaluru?**
A: A standard residential terrace waterproofing project (1,000 to 1,500 sq ft) typically takes 3 to 5 working days, including surface preparation, chemical application coats, and curing time.

**Q: Which waterproofing chemical brands do you use for structural repairs?**
A: Premium brands including Fosroc, Dr. Fixit, Sika, and Asian Paints SmartCare. The specific compound (epoxy, acrylic, or polyurethane) is selected based on leakage severity and surface type.

**Q: Do you provide a warranty on your leak-proofing and dampness treatments?**
A: Yes. All waterproofing and structural repair works are backed by a documented application warranty ranging from 5 to 10 years, depending on the chosen system.

**Q: Can third-party contractors rent construction machinery from Neelachandra?**
A: Yes. The commercial equipment rental fleet is available to independent contractors, developers, and individual home builders across Bangalore, regardless of whether Neelachandra is managing the primary construction project.

**Q: What types of construction equipment do you provide on rent in Bengaluru?**
A: Concrete mixers, transit mixers, earthmovers (JCBs), centering and shuttering materials (MS plates and props), structural scaffolding, concrete vibrators, and heavy-duty dewatering pumps for deep excavations.

**Q: Which areas in Bengaluru do your equipment rental services cover?**
A: Bangalore Urban and Rural, including Nelamangala, Doddaballapura, Whitefield, Sarjapur, Electronic City, and the entire Tumkur Road industrial corridor.

**Q: How are your equipment rental charges structured — daily vs. monthly?**
A: Flexible rental structures customized to project timeline: daily hire for short-term tasks or cost-effective monthly contracts for long-term projects. Transportation and operator costs are detailed transparently in the rental agreement.

**Q: How do you ensure standalone services do not disrupt neighboring properties?**
A: For urban renovation and waterproofing projects in tight residential layouts, strict site safety measures are implemented, including high-density debris netting, scheduled low-noise working hours, and careful structural propping.

**Q: How quickly can Neelachandra mobilize a team for a site assessment?**
A: A project manager or structural engineer can typically be deployed within 24 to 48 hours of an inquiry, for architectural consultations, renovation scoping, or urgent waterproofing inspections, across the greater Bangalore region.

## About Us
URL: https://neelachandra.com/about-us

### Overview
The Neelachandra Story: Why We Are Ranked Among the Best Construction Companies in Bengaluru.

Stats: 30+ Projects Delivered, 8+ Years of Experience, 100% Client Commitment, 4.8★ Average Rating.

### Company Story
Neelachandra Construction and Interiors was established in Bengaluru with the mission of delivering world class construction quality to a market historically underserved by contractors who overpromised and underdelivered. Founded by Chandrashekar T, the company began by delivering residential homes in Byraveshwara Nagara and throughout the NH-4 corridor. Its early reputation for material honesty, timeline discipline, and transparent communication allowed rapid growth, evolving from a local residential builder into a full-spectrum construction company trusted by India's largest real estate developers and leading industrial manufacturers.

Neelachandra's client portfolio has grown to include Godrej Properties, Salarpuria Sattva, Casagrand, Honda Cars India, Mandot Steel, and VRL Automation, while its headquarters remains rooted in Nelamangala, serving communities along the NH-4 corridor and across greater Karnataka.

### Six Pillars of NCC
- **On-Time Delivery** — Milestone-based project management framework dividing each project into clearly defined, measurable stages with transparent completion standards. A dedicated Project Coordinator oversees contractor scheduling, resource planning and on-site execution; each milestone requires formal client approval before progression.
- **Client-First Approach** — Complete transparency through weekly site photo reports, 24x7 digital site access, procurement records on request, and one dedicated Project Coordinator throughout.
- **Design Intelligence** — In-house architects and structural engineers develop drawings that are approval-ready for BBMP, BMRDA and Gram Panchayat, and practical to construct and cost efficient, customized to plot dimensions, orientation and soil profile.
- **Local Expertise** — Years of mastering Bengaluru's soil profiles, microclimate patterns, drainage conditions, and regulatory frameworks, gathered through projects across Nelamangala, Tumkur Road, Doddaballapura and the NH-4 corridor.
- **Structural Integrity** — Use of BIS certified materials including Ultratech cement and JSW TMT steel, sourced from verified vendors with complete invoice documentation; independent quality inspections at each structural milestone.
- **Sustainable Practices** — Responsible material sourcing, low-waste construction methods and water conservation systems as core standards; rainwater harvesting included in all packages; anti-termite treatment, Fosroc and Dr. Fixit waterproofing, and energy-efficient structural design built in by default.

### Mission and Vision
**Mission** — To deliver residential, commercial and industrial construction and interior solutions of the highest quality to every client in Bengaluru and Karnataka, regardless of project size, with transparent pricing, skilled execution and absolute structural safety.

**Vision** — To become the most trusted construction company in Bengaluru and across Karnataka, recognized for the integrity and quality brought to every project, contributing long-term to the communities and evolving urban skylines of Karnataka.

### The Team
Neelachandra's professional workforce is structured around specialist business units for design, engineering, and site management.

- **Chandrashekar T — Founder.** Brings over a decade of hands-on construction experience across Bengaluru and the NH-4 corridor. His philosophy: build with engineering precision, communicate with absolute honesty, and stand behind every structure delivered.
- **Naveen Kumar — Chief Technical Advisor.** Naveen brings deep technical expertise to every Neelachandra project, overseeing engineering standards and construction methodology from planning through execution. Working closely with the project and procurement teams, he resolves technical challenges early and ensures every build meets rigorous quality benchmarks, upholding Neelachandra's standing as the best construction company in Bengaluru.
- **Sushma N — Operations Analyst.** Oversees operations and quality control across the active project portfolio, ensuring adherence to documented project plans with material verification, milestone sign-offs, and clear client communication.
- **Vinay — Procurement Lead.** Responsible for material sourcing, vendor relationships, and procurement documentation, ensuring every project uses specified branded materials like Ultratech, JSW, Finolex, Asian Paints, and Jaquar, fully traceable and documented.

### Why Homeowners and Developers Choose Neelachandra
**Transparent Cost Estimates with No Escalation** — Pricing is fully itemized, signed, and fixed at the time of agreement, with no mid-project cost escalation. Every BOQ line item is explained before construction begins.

### About Us / Company FAQ

**Q: Who founded Neelachandra Construction, and where is the corporate office located?**
A: Neelachandra was founded by Chandrashekar T with a vision to bring structural integrity and transparency to home building. The company is headquartered at #193/1c NH-4, Near Harsha Hospital, Byraveshwara Nagara, Nelamangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562123.

**Q: Is Neelachandra a licensed, registered, and insured construction company in Karnataka?**
A: Yes, Neelachandra Construction and Interiors is a fully licensed and registered corporate entity operating under Karnataka business regulations, holding statutory registrations, tax compliances, and corporate insurances required for large-scale residential, commercial, and industrial engineering projects.

**Q: Does Neelachandra undertake house construction projects across the entire city?**
A: Neelachandra executes residential construction projects across all zones of greater Bangalore, including North Bangalore, Whitefield, Sarjapur, Electronic City, Kanakapura Road, Nelamangala, Doddaballapura, and the Tumkur Road corridor.

**Q: Can Neelachandra build commercial or industrial projects outside of Bengaluru?**
A: Yes. While the primary residential footprint is in Bengaluru and surrounding sub-districts, the commercial and industrial construction divisions operate state-wide, including Hassan, Mysuru, Tumakuru, and other major commercial hubs in Karnataka.

**Q: What makes Neelachandra different from local building contractors in Bengaluru?**
A: Neelachandra operates as a professional turnkey company, providing fixed-price contracts with no cost escalations, strict milestone-based payment timelines, an in-house team of qualified structural engineers and architects, and a legally binding 10-year structural warranty.

**Q: How does Neelachandra guarantee transparent pricing with zero cost escalations?**
A: By providing a comprehensive, itemized Bill of Quantities (BOQ) before any contract is signed. Every brand of cement, steel, plumbing, and electrical fixture is locked into the agreement for complete financial clarity from excavation to handover.

**Q: Does Neelachandra have an in-house team, or do you subcontract the entire project?**
A: Neelachandra employs an in-house core team of experienced architects, structural engineers, project managers, and quality control auditors, maintaining strict oversight on material quality and execution timelines with minimal reliance on external subcontractors for critical structural phases.

**Q: How does Neelachandra ensure the structural safety of its buildings?**
A: The in-house engineering team designs custom foundations based on site-specific soil testing reports, strictly adhering to Indian Standard (IS) codes for reinforcement detailing, concrete mix designs, and seismic factors.

**Q: What government approval workflows does Neelachandra manage for clients?**
A: The liaison team manages the entire technical documentation and drawing pipeline required to secure building plan sanctions, including approvals from BBMP, BMRDA, BIAPPA, and local Gram Panchayats, depending on plot location.

**Q: How do you verify the quality of materials delivered to the construction site?**
A: A multi-stage quality assurance checklist is used. Every batch of Tier-1 steel (like JSW or Tata) and cement (like UltraTech) is checked for manufacturing dates and test certificates, with regular on-site slump tests and laboratory cube tests to verify concrete compressive strength.

**Q: Can I visit an ongoing Neelachandra construction site in Bengaluru?**
A: Yes. Prospective clients are encouraged to visit active sites or completed projects in Bengaluru and Nelamangala to inspect construction quality, finishing standards, and safety protocols, and interact with site engineers directly.

**Q: How does Neelachandra manage project communication with NRI clients?**
A: A streamlined digital project tracking experience is offered, with regular weekly progress reports, site photographs, and video updates from a dedicated Project Coordinator, giving full visibility without needing to visit the site physically.

**Q: What structural and waterproofing warranties does Neelachandra provide?**
A: Every residential project comes with a legally backed 10-year structural warranty covering foundations, columns, beams, and slabs, plus a 1-year warranty covering waterproofing integrity and finishing installations.

**Q: How does the company handle sustainable or eco-friendly building practices?**
A: Sustainable engineering practices are integrated across all builds, including standardized rainwater harvesting systems compliant with BBMP guidelines, layouts optimized for natural light and cross-ventilation, and eco-friendly building material options like solid concrete blocks or clay bricks.

**Q: What architectural design styles does your team specialize in for premium villas?**
A: The architectural division works across a wide range of design philosophies, from sleek minimalist ultra-modern villas to traditional Indian home layouts to efficient contemporary multi-floor residences, tailored to client aesthetic and functional preferences.
